name: KyNotes
description: End-to-end encrypted notes with text, handwriting and team notebooks.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database, the encrypted notes and attachments, and the server's keys. Back up the whole folder; KyNotes can also make sealed backups to KyRecovery.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: KyNotes web app and API, published on host as 6696

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: The port KyNotes listens on inside the container. Leave it as 8080.

variables.name: KYNOTES_DATA_DIR
variables.description: Where KyNotes keeps its data inside the container. Leave it as /data.
